gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-tiktok-sans: Neon-glass tubing, loosely spaced: Galaxy glows like a sign in deep space. TikTok Sans takes over for long reading, plain sans in spirit, with lowercase rising nearly to cap height and a generously opened c.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-ubuntu-sans: Loose and tall, Galaxy holds every letter to a single line width, with room between them. Ubuntu Sans adds big-eyed lowercase and tubular strokes like bent copper pipe, a sturdy partner for that spacious heading.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-vend-sans: Galaxy stacks dense, tall lowercase with loose spacing, every stroke kept to a single line width, cosmic and commanding. Vend Sans then reads plain and ruler-straight, its x-height filling the line.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-yaldevi: Galaxy joins its strokes without a bulge or a thin spot, spacing the letters out like stars. Yaldevi, sans with outsized lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right, keeps paragraphs moving.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-abeezee: Friendly and a bit funky, Groovy nearly closes its c to a slit. ABeeZee goes the other way once the text starts, its open terminals finishing well away from the stem under a high mean line.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-aldrich: Groovy is loose and funky, its c nearly shut. Aldrich sits beside it with plain sans lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and round letters that look cupped, so the two never crowd each other.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-alexandria: Groovy squeezes its c nearly shut and spaces the lowercase loosely, a friendly, funky headline. Alexandria brings plain sans terminals that swing wide open, giving the pairing a relaxed footing.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-amiko: Amiko reads modern and plain, its lowercase strokes crayon-tall and its terminals pointing outward like a pair of tongs. Groovy is the one for display punch, Amiko the one for steady text.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla is contemporary plain sans with wide s curves that barely curl in and a short climb to the ascender. Groovy does the playful squeezing; Anek Bangla keeps its letters open.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari brings distinctly open letter mouths and a tall middle zone, plain sans through and through. Anek Devanagari's best trick is staying open beside Groovy, whose c nearly closes and whose strokes never thin.
